description: Source code for managing credentials in Git, including functions for initializing, clearing, matching, reading, writing, and interacting with credential helpers and URLs.

methods.name: void credential_init(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Initializes a credential struct to default state.

methods.name: void credential_clear(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Clears sensitive data and resets the credential struct.

methods.name: void credential_next_state(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Advances the credential's state headers to the next stage.

methods.name: void credential_clear_secrets(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Frees secrets like password and credential fields.

methods.name: void credential_set_capability(struct credential_capability * capa,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Sets a specific capability flag in credential_capability.

methods.name: void credential_set_all_capabilities(struct credential * c,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Enables all capabilities on a credential based on operation type.

methods.name: void credential_announce_capabilities(struct credential * c,FILE * fp)
methods.description: Prints the capabilities announced to a given output.

methods.name: int credential_match(const struct credential * want,const struct credential * have,int match_password)
methods.description: Checks if two credentials match based on specified fields.

methods.name: void credential_apply_config(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Applies credential-related repository configuration.

methods.name: void credential_describe(struct credential * c,struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of a credential.

methods.name: void credential_format(struct credential * c,struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Formats a credential into a normalized URL string.

methods.name: char * credential_ask_one(const char * what,struct credential * c,int flags)
methods.description: Prompts the user for a credential component (username/password).

methods.name: int credential_getpass(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Handles prompting for password interaction.

methods.name: int credential_has_capability(const struct credential_capability * capa,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Checks whether a capability is present for an operation.

methods.name: int credential_read(struct credential * c,FILE * fp,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Reads credential data from a file stream.

methods.name: void credential_write(const struct credential * c,FILE * fp,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Writes credential data to a file stream.

methods.name: void credential_fill(struct repository * r,struct credential * c,int all_capabilities)
methods.description: Fills in missing credential info by calling helpers and prompting.

methods.name: void credential_approve(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Stores validated credentials via helpers.

methods.name: void credential_reject(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Rejects and clears credentials, calling erase helpers.

methods.name: void credential_from_url(struct credential * c,const char * url)
methods.description: Parses a URL into a credential struct, rejecting partial URLs.
